sequential_semantics: At every positive clk edge, reset=1 sets A; otherwise apply transition table using sampled in.
combinational_semantics: Moore out equals 1 exactly in D, else 0; no direct dependence on in/reset.
latency_reset_behavior: State and decoded out update after each positive edge. Synchronous active-high reset has priority. No specified initial state before reset.
specification_ambiguities: Initial state before a reset clock edge is unspecified.
verification_plan: All 256 eight-bit input sequences from reset with independent integer reference FSM
Coverage assertion for all eight state/input transition pairs
Midcycle input stability and synchronous reset assertion from D
Reset priority for both input values
skill_exceptions: Benchmark names and reset override defaults; no reuse search or synthesis allowed by policy.
